text: On the first day of the second month of the second year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt (land of bondage), the LORD {YHWH} spoke to Moses (drawn out) in the Tent of Meeting in the Wilderness of Sinai (thorny). He said:
“Take a census of the whole congregation of Israel (he wrestles with God) by their clans and families, listing every man by name, one by one.
You and Aaron (light bringer) are to number those who are twenty years of age or older by their divisions—everyone who can serve in Israel’s (he wrestles with God) army.
And one man from each tribe, the head of each family, must be there with you⁺.
These are the names of the men who are to assist you⁺: From the tribe of Reuben (behold a son), Elizur (my God is a rock) son of Shedeur (darter of light);
from Simeon (heard), Shelumiel (friend of God) son of Zurishaddai (my rock is almighty);
from Judah (praised), Nahshon (enchanter) son of Amminadab (my kinsman is noble);
from Issachar (there is recompense), Nethanel (given of God) son of Zuar (littleness);
from Zebulun (exalted), Eliab (God is father) son of Helon (strength);

from the sons of Joseph (YHWH has added): from Ephraim (doubly fruitful), Elishama (my God has heard) son of Ammihud (my kinsman is majesty), and from Manasseh (causing to forget), Gamaliel (reward of God) son of Pedahzur (the Rock has ransomed);
from Benjamin (son of the right hand), Abidan (my father is judge) son of Gideoni (my hewer);
from Dan (He has judged), Ahiezer (my brother is help) son of Ammishaddai (my kinsman is Almighty);
from Asher (happy), Pagiel (event of God) son of Ocran (troubled);
from Gad (troop), Eliasaph (God has added) son of Deuel (they know God);
and from Naphtali (wrestling), Ahira (my brother is evil) son of Enan (having eyes).”
These men were appointed from the congregation; they were the leaders of the tribes of their fathers, the heads of the clans of Israel (he wrestles with God).
So Moses (drawn out) and Aaron (light bringer) took these men who had been designated by name,
and on the first day of the second month they assembled the whole congregation and recorded their ancestry by clans and families, counting one by one the names of those twenty years of age or older,
just as the LORD {YHWH} had commanded Moses (drawn out). So Moses numbered them in the Wilderness of Sinai (thorny):

From the sons of Reuben (behold a son), the firstborn of Israel (he wrestles with God), according to the records of their clans and families, counting one by one the names of every male twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
those registered to the tribe of Reuben (behold a son) numbered 46,500.
From the sons of Simeon (heard), according to the records of their clans and families, counting one by one the names of every male twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
those registered to the tribe of Simeon (heard) numbered 59,300.
From the sons of Gad (troop), according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
those registered to the tribe of Gad (troop) numbered 45,650.
From the sons of Judah (praised), according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
those registered to the tribe of Judah (praised) numbered 74,600.
From the sons of Issachar (there is recompense), according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
those registered to the tribe of Issachar (there is recompense) numbered 54,400.
From the sons of Zebulun (exalted), according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
those registered to the tribe of Zebulun (exalted) numbered 57,400.

From the sons of Joseph (YHWH has added): From the sons of Ephraim (doubly fruitful), according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
those registered to the tribe of Ephraim (doubly fruitful) numbered 40,500.
And from the sons of Manasseh (causing to forget), according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
those registered to the tribe of Manasseh (causing to forget) numbered 32,200.
From the sons of Benjamin (son of the right hand), according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
those registered to the tribe of Benjamin (son of the right hand) numbered 35,400.
From the sons of Dan (He has judged), according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
those registered to the tribe of Dan (He has judged) numbered 62,700.
From the sons of Asher (happy), according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
those registered to the tribe of Asher (happy) numbered 41,500.
From the sons of Naphtali (wrestling), according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
those registered to the tribe of Naphtali (wrestling) numbered 53,400.
These were the men numbered by Moses (drawn out) and Aaron (light bringer), with the assistance of the twelve leaders of Israel (he wrestles with God), each one representing his family.
So all the Israelites (God prevails) twenty years of age or older who could serve in Israel’s army were counted according to their families.
And all those counted totaled 603,550.
The Levites, however, were not numbered along with them by the tribe of their fathers.
For the LORD {YHWH} had said to Moses (drawn out):
“Do not number the tribe of Levi (joined to) in the census with the other Israelites (God prevails).

Instead, you are to appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the Testimony, all its furnishings, and everything in it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its articles, care for it, and camp around it.
Whenever the tabernacle is to move, the Levites are to take it down, and whenever it is to be pitched, the Levites are to set it up. Any outsider who goes near it must be put to death.
The Israelites (God prevails) are to camp by their divisions, each man in his own camp and under his own standard.

But the Levites are to camp around the tabernacle of the Testimony and watch over it, so that no wrath will fall on the congregation of Israel (he wrestles with God). So the Levites are responsible for the tabernacle of the Testimony.”
Thus the Israelites (God prevails) did everything just as the LORD {YHWH} had commanded Moses (drawn out).
